name: Slide in text
summary: A word or phrase that slides in from a chosen side behind a mask with an ease-out, for lower thirds and headers.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame; overrides at when set

params.name: size
params.note: font size; shrinks to fit 960 px

params.name: dir
params.note: side it enters from; up = from below, down = from above

params.name: seed
params.note: unique id prefix for the mask

author: krakujs
